title: Joomla security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-060.110917: TT-CSIRT Advisory – Joomla Security Updates
leadParagraph: Joomla has released security updates to address the following vulnerabilities:
contentHtml:
Joomla has released security updates to address the following vulnerabilities:

a) Medium Priority – Core – LDAP Information Disclosure (affecting Joomla! 1.5.0 through 3.8.1)

b) Medium Priority – Core – Two-Factor Authentication Bypass (affecting Joomla! 3.2.0 through 3.8.1)

c) Low Priority – Core – Information Disclosure (affecting Joomla! 3.7.0 through 3.8.1)

Further information on these vulnerabilities and how they can be fixed can be found on the Joomla Website at https://www.joomla.org/announcements/release-news/5716-joomla-3-8-2-release.html
